snapshot_digest.canonical_stream: For every regular file beneath the snapshot, sort relative paths by raw byte value under LC_ALL=C. Emit one UTF-8 line per file as '<normalized-mode> <decimal-byte-count> <lowercase-file-sha256>\t<relative-path>\n'. normalized-mode is 100755 when the extracted file is executable and 100644 otherwise. Hash the concatenated lines. Git contains no empty directories, and these snapshots contain no symlinks.

frozen_property_check.focal_assumption: Every invocation of the read-query operation can arrive only through the local process's STDIO transport; it cannot be invoked directly by an unauthenticated network client.
frozen_property_check.source: mcp_pinot/server.py constructs the MCP server and runs it only through mcp.server.stdio.stdio_server(). No network listener was found for read-query.
frozen_property_check.compatible: mcp_pinot/server.py continues to run the MCP server only through mcp.server.stdio.stdio_server(); manifest.json also describes a Python STDIO launch. No network listener was found for read-query.

runtime_assessment.project_runtime: Python. pyproject.toml declares Python >=3.10 at S, C, and I. Upstream CI selects Python 3.11. The C/I Dockerfile base is python:3.10-slim.
runtime_assessment.package_and_locking: The project uses a PEP 517 setuptools build and documents uv for environment/package operations. All three revisions include uv.lock.
runtime_assessment.tests: pytest is the upstream test framework, with pytest-asyncio, pytest-mock, and pytest-cov in the dev extra; C/I also configure ruff. Most unit tests mock Pinot or transport objects. tests/test_remote_cluster.py is explicitly skipped. tests/test_service/test_pinot_quickstart.py and the corresponding CI workflow require a live local Apache Pinot quickstart container on controller port 9000 and broker port 8000. I adds mocked HTTP transport/integration tests plus tests/test_http_live.py, which targets a running local HTTP server.
runtime_assessment.service_and_network_assumptions: Normal server operations require a reachable Apache Pinot controller/broker configured by environment, defaulting at C/I to localhost:9000 and localhost:8000. Live service tests use Docker and the apachepinot/pinot:latest image. Deterministic unit-level evaluation can avoid live Pinot by replacing the Pinot client with a local controlled stub; the historical production server itself is not self-contained without Pinot.
